scenes.title: Open a page first
captions: Expand Discovery and choose End Point Explorer.
Choose Select managed networks to open the selection control.

scenes.title: Choose networks or ICT systems
captions: Search by name or ID, then tick the networks you need.
Choose Update. An ICT system selection would replace these networks.

scenes.title: Set Security Domain
captions: Open Security Domain. Keep PROTECTED; untick SECRET and UNKNOWN.
Choose Update. Keep at least one domain and a network or ICT system.

scenes.title: Check which snapshot was loaded
captions: Set Date to 4 November 2026, then check Snapshot on the page.
Snapshot is 31 October: the most recent saved data on or before the chosen date.

scenes.title: Keep the same selection as you work
captions: Open Installed Software Explorer. Your selections carry across.
Before sharing a result, check networks or systems, domains and the loaded snapshot.

captureMethod: Playwright screencast of the guide-launched practice lab; caption, pointer and focus overlays only.
